about: Italy: CAV's unit toll rates per km for 2026 by section and class, published by the operator only as an image (file name tool_rates_2026.jpg) on its Toll rates page ('Unit rates for users on the CAV network (including the Concession Fee paid to ANAS and VAT)'). Transcribed by hand; tools/tables fetches the image again and says if it has changed (sha256). Per section: kur, the Kilometre Unit Rate; anas, the fee under art. 15 paragraph 4 letter B Law 122/2010; user, the user kilometre rate including VAT (22%), euro per km. Sections: A4 (Padova Est - Conn. A4/A13 - Conn. A4/A57), A57 (Conn. A4/A57 - Mirano-Dolo - Mira-Oriago - Venezia Mestre), Passante (Section A4 (Bypass): Conn. A4/A57 - Spinea - Martellago-Scorzè - Preganziol - Conn. A4/A27 - Conn. A57/A4).
